inputLimits.hint: Vide = illimité, 0 = type d'entrée non pris en charge. Si les images dépassent la limite, l'image de départ est d'abord abandonnée, puis depuis la fin ; audio/vidéo sont rognés depuis la fin. La concurrence globale plafonne les tâches en cours de ce modèle pour tous les utilisateurs ; les tâches en excès patientent dans la file. Le compteur est reconstruit depuis les tâches en cours au redémarrage du serveur.

s1.title: Information We Collect
s1.item1: Account information: basic information such as your account identifier, nickname, email address, and phone number obtained after logging in through the xworld unified account.
s1.item2: Uploaded materials: scripts, prompts, images, audio, video, and other materials you actively upload or enter for creation purposes.
s1.item3: AI generation records: task parameters, generation results, task status, and related archived records produced when you use the generation features.
s1.item4: Log information: device and browser information, IP address, access time, page visits, and operation logs, used to safeguard service security and troubleshoot failures.

s2.title: How We Use Information
s2.item1: To create and manage your account and to provide identity verification and login services.
s2.item2: To execute the generation tasks you initiate and to display, store, and manage your creations.
s2.item3: To perform billing and settlement, respond to customer service requests, conduct security risk control, troubleshoot failures, and improve service quality.
s2.item4: To send you service notifications and campaign information within the scope of your consent; you may unsubscribe from non-essential notifications at any time.

s3.title: Storage and Protection
s3.item1: Your information is stored on servers located within the People's Republic of China; where a cross-border transfer is genuinely required, we will fulfill the applicable obligations such as security assessment in accordance with the law.
s3.item2: We adopt technical and administrative measures such as access control, encryption in transit, time-limited signed media links (hotlink protection), and log auditing to prevent information from being accessed, altered, disclosed, or lost without authorization.
s3.item3: Information is retained for the minimum period necessary to achieve the purposes described in this Policy; beyond that period it will be deleted or anonymized, except as otherwise required by laws and regulations.

s4.title: Third-Party Services
s4.item1: xworld unified account: registration and login are hosted by the xworld authorization center, which processes your account information under its own privacy policy.
s4.item2: WeChat Pay: top-up and payment services are provided by WeChat Pay; we only receive the order number, payment status, and other information necessary to complete the transaction, and never come into contact with your payment password.
s4.item3: AI model vendors: to complete generation tasks, we submit the necessary prompts and materials to the vendor service corresponding to the model you selected; the vendor processing is subject to its own terms of service and privacy policy.
s4.item4: Hotlink protection: links to media files carry time-limited signatures used to prevent the storage resources from being hotlinked or abused.

s5.title: Your Rights
s5.item1: You may access and correct your account information within the Platform, delete your projects, generation records, and uploaded materials, or cancel your account.
s5.item2: After you cancel your account, we will delete or anonymize your personal information within the period required by law.
s5.item3: You may exercise the above rights through the in-Platform settings or the published customer service channels, and we will verify and respond within our committed time limits.

s6.title: Protection of Minors
s6.item1: The Platform services are intended for adults. Minors may use the Platform only under the accompaniment and with the consent of a guardian, who should help them read this Policy.
s6.item2: We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If a guardian discovers that a minor has provided personal information to us without their consent, they may contact us to have it deleted.

s7.title: Changes to This Policy
s7.item1: This Policy may be updated from time to time. For material changes, we will notify you through Platform announcements or in-Platform notices.
s7.item2: The updated Policy takes effect on the date it is published on this page; your continued use of the Platform after an update constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.

s8.title: Contact Us
s8.item1: If you have any questions, comments, or complaints regarding this Policy, please contact us through the customer service channels published within the Platform, and we will verify and handle the matter promptly.
